fullDescription:
Beautifully coordinated stickers perfect for a themed layout in your planner or journal! A large assortment of chic and minimalistic sticker options, in a PRINTABLE “Do it Yourself” format!

★ INCLUDED ★
6 PNG files (coordinated sticker pages)
6 DXF files to use as cutlines in popular machines such as Silhouette and Cricut

★ HOW TO USE ★
For planning friends with an electronic cutting machine (such as a Silhouette or Cricut), the image files and cut lines are ready for you to create pages in your cutting software! DXF cutlines are included!

Example Use:
–Open the PNG in your machine’s software
–Open the matching DXF file; your software will recognize the DXF as a cutline!
–Copy the DXF cutlines and Paste them onto the matching PNG or PDF. Align.
–Use your favorite “kiss cut” settings and GO!
